breve: Base class for VisualShader nodes. Not related to scene nodes.
descricao: Visual shader graphs consist of various nodes. Each node in the graph is a separate object and they are represented as a rectangular boxes with title and a set of properties. Each node also has connection ports that allow to connect it to another nodes and control the flow of the shader.

metodos.desc: Clears the default input ports value.
Returns the input port which should be connected by default when this node is created as a result of dragging a connection from an existing node to the empty space on the graph.
Returns an Array containing default values for all of the input ports of the node in the form [index0, value0, index1, value1, ...].
Returns the default value of the input 'port'.
Removes the default value of the input 'port'.
Sets the default input ports values using an Array of the form [index0, value0, index1, value1, ...]. For example: [0, Vector3(0, 0, 0), 1, Vector3(0, 0, 0)].

metodos.assinatura: set_input_port_default_value(port: int, value: Variant, prev_value: Variant = null) -> void
metodos.desc: Sets the default 'value' for the selected input 'port'.

propriedades.desc: Represents the index of the frame this node is linked to. If set to -1 the node is not linked to any frame.
Sets the output port index which will be showed for preview. If set to -1 no port will be open for preview.
